description: We are a team of four students participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are passionate about space, science, technology, and innovation. We are working on the "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" challenge. We are beginners who are eager to learn, collaborate, share ideas, and build a creative project together.
summary: AstroNex is an interactive educational game designed for children aged 7–12 to simulate managing a lunar or Martian outpost. Players take on the role of mission managers, make important decisions, manage limited resources, and respond to different challenges to keep their space station safe and operational. Through interactive scenarios and decision-making activities, the game helps children understand the challenges of space exploration while developing critical thinking, problem-solving, and resource management skills. AstroNex makes learning about space more engaging, practical, and enjoyable for young explorers.
details: AstroNex is an interactive web-based educational game designed for children aged 7–12. It allows players to experience the challenges of managing a lunar or Martian outpost through different space exploration activities. Players can explore planets, complete astronaut missions, solve challenges, and learn about space science through interactive gameplay. The platform includes activities such as planet motion challenges, memory games, astronaut missions, and Mars rover exploration. The main objective is to teach children how astronauts and mission managers make decisions in challenging space environments. Players develop problem-solving, critical thinking, memory, and decision-making skills while learning about space exploration. AstroNex combines education and entertainment to make complex scientific concepts easier to understand. Its interactive design encourages curiosity, creativity, and learning through practical experiences. The project is available as a web-based application and is hosted on Vercel.
